title: From code to cure: computational identification of LasR inhibitors to combat quorum sensing in P. aeruginosa.
authors: Chowdhury, Subarnarekha; Kumar, Mukesh; Rawat, Shivani; Singh, Shweta; Kaur, Punit
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过分子对接和MD模拟筛选铜绿假单胞菌LasR蛋白（转录因子）的小分子抑制剂，虽涉及蛋白-配体互作建模，但对象为蛋白-小分子而非蛋白-DNA互作，方法可迁移性有限，仅部分相关。
abstract: Biofilm formation by Pseudomonas aeruginosa (PA) poses a significant challenge in clinical settings due to its contribution to chronic infections and antibiotic resistance. Quorum sensing (QS), particularly regulated by the LasR receptor, plays a crucial role in biofilm development and virulence. In this study, an integrative in silico approach was employed to identify the potential LasR inhibitors. Molecular docking predicted binding affinities of candidate molecules, followed by molecular dynamics simulations to assess complex stability in a dynamic system. Druggability analysis, quantum mechanical evaluation via density functional theory, and binding free energy calculations refined the selection, yielding six promising inhibitors. Among these, compounds 26529, 22498, and 25412 showed strong binding within the LasR-ligand-binding domain, engaging key residues such as Tyr56, Trp60, Asp73, and Ser129. Notably, compound 26529 formed an additional pi-cation interaction with Trp88, providing greater stabilization than typical hydrogen bonds and distinguishing it as the lead molecule. ADMET profiling further confirmed their favorable pharmacokinetic and toxicity properties, selecting the most drug-like candidates. The findings align with the previous reports targeting LasR to attenuate PA virulence and biofilm formation. However, experimental validation remains essential to confirm their therapeutic efficacy. Overall, this study highlights promising QS inhibitors as potential anti-virulence agents against PA.
abstract_zh: 铜绿假单胞菌（Pseudomonas aeruginosa, PA）生物膜的形成在临床环境中构成重大挑战，因其导致慢性感染和抗生素耐药性。群体感应（quorum sensing, QS），特别是由LasR受体调控的机制，在生物膜发育和毒力中发挥关键作用。本研究采用整合性计算机模拟方法，以识别潜在的LasR抑制剂。分子对接预测了候选分子的结合亲和力，随后进行分子动力学模拟以评估动态系统中的复合物稳定性。药物可及性分析、基于密度泛函理论的量子力学评估以及结合自由能计算进一步优化了筛选，最终获得六种有前景的抑制剂。其中，化合物26529、22498和25412在LasR配体结合域内表现出强结合，涉及关键残基如Tyr56、Trp60、Asp73和Ser129。值得注意的是，化合物26529与Trp88形成额外的π-阳离子相互作用，提供比典型氢键更强的稳定性，使其成为先导分子。ADMET分析进一步确认了其良好的药代动力学和毒性特性，筛选出最具药物样性的候选物。研究结果与先前靶向LasR以减弱PA毒力和生物膜形成的报道一致。然而，实验验证仍为确认其治疗功效所必需。总体而言，本研究强调了有前景的QS抑制剂作为针对PA的抗毒力剂的潜力。
